objective: Reduce System engineering wall-clock time and redundant CI/tool polling without weakening authority, mutation permission, evidence, promotion, rollback, or live read-back guarantees.

system-pwa-ci already owns focused PWA/public projection and cosmetic-effect verification.
system-cloud-ci owns model/runtime/PostgreSQL/Docker verification and should not be invoked solely because a PWA-only test file changed.
projects/lifeup-system.md remains the continuity owner for System project state.

role_dispositions.destination: Fast-path guidance changes sequencing and batching only; existing authority, evidence and permission rules remain intact.
